slides.h:
Fungi · 1/9

What makes a fungus a fungus?真菌的特征

Fungi are eukaryotes with chitin cell walls. They cannot photosynthesize. They absorb nutrients from their surroundings.真菌是细胞壁含几丁质的真核生物，不能光合作用，靠吸收周围的养分生活。

Fungi · 2/9

Hyphae and mycelium菌丝与菌丝体

A hypha is one thread. Many hyphae branch into a mycelium. A mushroom is only the reproductive part above ground.一条菌丝是一根细丝；许多菌丝分枝形成菌丝体；蘑菇只是长出地面的繁殖部分。

Fungi · 3/9

How fungi eat真菌怎样进食

Fungi release enzymes into their food, digest it outside the body, and absorb the small molecules. This is extracellular digestion.真菌向食物中释放酶，在体外消化，再吸收小分子，这就是胞外消化。

Fungi · 4/9

How fungi reproduce真菌怎样繁殖

Fungi spread by spores. Yeast also reproduces by budding. A piece of mycelium can regrow by fragmentation.真菌靠孢子传播；酵母还用出芽生殖；一段菌丝体可以通过断裂再长成新个体。

Fungi · 5/9

Three fungus groups三大类真菌

Zygote fungi include bread mold. Sac fungi include yeast and Penicillium. Club fungi include mushrooms.接合菌包括面包霉；子囊菌包括酵母和青霉；担子菌包括蘑菇。

Fungi · 6/9

Decomposers分解者

Fungi break down dead organisms and return nutrients to the soil. Without them, dead matter would pile up and nutrients would be locked away.真菌分解死亡的生物，把养分还给土壤。没有它们，死亡物质会堆积，养分被锁住。

Fungi · 7/9

Mycorrhiza菌根

Fungus threads extend the plant's root reach. The fungus gets sugar from the plant. The plant gets water and minerals. Both gain.菌丝延伸了植物根的范围；真菌从植物得到糖，植物得到水和矿物质，双方都受益。

Fungi · 8/9

Lichens地衣

A lichen is a fungus plus an alga or cyanobacterium. The alga makes food. The fungus gives shelter. Lichens start soil on bare rock.地衣是真菌加藻类或蓝细菌；藻类制造食物，真菌提供庇护。地衣在裸岩上开始形成土壤。

Fungi · 9/9

Useful and harmful fungi有益与有害的真菌

Yeast bakes bread and brews drinks. Penicillium gives us penicillin. Some fungi cause athlete's foot, ringworm or spoil food.酵母用来烘焙和酿造；青霉产生青霉素；有些真菌引起脚气、癣，或使食物变质。

cards.f: FUN·gus
cards.b:
A eukaryote with a chitin cell wall that feeds by absorbing nutrients from its surroundings. Plural: fungi.

真菌：细胞壁含几丁质、靠吸收周围养分获取营养的真核生物，复数 fungi。

🧠 fungus = Latin for mushroom.fungus 在拉丁语里是「蘑菇」。

Quick check: Can a fungus photosynthesize?

No. It absorbs food from its surroundings.

cards.f: HY·pha
cards.b:
A thin thread of cells that forms the body of most fungi. Plural: hyphae.

菌丝：构成大多数真菌身体的细丝状细胞。复数 hyphae。

🧠 hyphe = Greek for web.hyphe 在希腊语里是「网」。

Quick check: What is a hypha?

A thread-like filament that makes up a fungus.

cards.f: my·CE·li·um
cards.b:
A mass of branching hyphae that makes up the main body of a fungus.

菌丝体：由许多分枝菌丝构成的真菌主体。

🧠 myco = fungus.myco = 真菌。

Quick check: What is the main body of most fungi?

The mycelium.

cards.f: CHI·tin
cards.b:
A tough, flexible material that forms the cell walls of fungi. It also makes insect shells.

几丁质：构成真菌细胞壁的坚韧有韧性的物质，也构成昆虫外壳。

🧠 chitin ~ "tunic" in Greek.chitin 在希腊语里近似「外衣」。

Quick check: What material is in fungal cell walls?

Chitin.

cards.f: SPORE
cards.b:
A tiny reproductive cell that can grow into a new organism without joining another cell.

孢子：微小的繁殖细胞，不需要与其他细胞结合就能长成新个体。

🧠 spora = seed in Greek.spora 在希腊语里是「种子」。

Quick check: Do spores need fertilization to grow?

No. A spore can grow on its own.

cards.f: MOLD
cards.b:
A fungus that grows as fuzzy masses of hyphae on food or damp surfaces.

霉菌：在食物或潮湿表面形成绒毛状菌丝团的真菌。

🧠 mold on bread is a living network.面包上的霉是活的菌丝网。

Quick check: Is bread mold a plant?

No. It is a fungus.

cards.f: YEAST
cards.b:
A single-celled fungus that reproduces by budding and can ferment sugar.

酵母：单细胞真菌，靠出芽繁殖，能发酵糖。

🧠 one of the few common single-celled fungi.常见真菌里少有的单细胞种类。

Quick check: Is yeast single-celled or multicellular?

Single-celled.

cards.f: MUSH·room
cards.b:
The visible reproductive structure of some fungi. The main body is the hidden mycelium.

蘑菇：某些真菌可见的繁殖结构，真正的主体是隐藏的菌丝体。

🧠 A mushroom is like an apple on a tree.蘑菇像树上的苹果，主体在地下。

Quick check: What is a mushroom to the fungus?

Its reproductive structure (fruiting body).

cards.f: BUD·ding
cards.b:
Asexual reproduction in which a small outgrowth pinches off to form a new cell.

出芽生殖：无性繁殖方式：一个小突起脱落后成为新个体。

🧠 bud = a young outgrowth.bud = 幼芽。

Quick check: Which fungus reproduces by budding?

Yeast.

cards.f: frag·men·TA·tion
cards.b:
Reproduction when a piece of a fungus breaks off and grows into a new fungus.

断裂生殖：真菌的一段断开后长成新的真菌。

🧠 fragment = broken piece.fragment = 碎片。

Quick check: Can a piece of mycelium grow into a new fungus?

Yes, by fragmentation.

cards.f: ex·tra·CEL·lu·lar di·GES·tion
cards.b:
Digesting food outside the body by releasing enzymes, then absorbing the nutrients.

胞外消化：向体外释放酶消化食物，再把养分吸收进来。

🧠 extra = outside, cellular = cell.extra = 外面。

Quick check: Where does digestion happen in a fungus?

Outside its body, before absorption.

cards.f: EN·zyme
cards.b:
A protein that speeds up a chemical reaction, such as breaking down food.

酶：加快化学反应的蛋白质，如分解食物。

🧠 en = in, zyme = leaven (yeast): the name means "in yeast".en = 在……里，zyme = 酵母：名字意为「在酵母中」。

Quick check: What does an enzyme do?

It speeds up a chemical reaction.

cards.f: SAP·ro·troph
cards.b:
An organism that feeds on dead or decaying matter.

腐生生物：以死亡或腐烂的有机物为食的生物。

🧠 sapros = rotten, troph = feeding.sapros = 腐烂，troph = 营养。

Quick check: Name a saprotroph.

A mushroom or bread mold.

cards.f: PAR·a·site
cards.b:
An organism that lives on or in a host and harms it.

寄生生物：生活在宿主体表或体内并损害宿主的生物。

🧠 para = beside, sitos = food. Eats beside you.para = 旁边，sitos = 食物。

Quick check: Does a parasite harm its host?

Yes.

cards.f: sym·bi·O·sis
cards.b:
A close, long-term relationship between two different species.

共生：两个不同物种之间紧密而长期的关系。

🧠 sym = together, bio = life.sym = 一起，bio = 生活。

Quick check: Is symbiosis always helpful to both partners?

No. It can help both, one, or harm one.

cards.f: my·cor·RHI·za
cards.b:
A partnership between a fungus and plant roots: the fungus gets sugar and the plant gets water and minerals.

菌根：真菌与植物根的合作：真菌得到糖，植物得到水和矿物质。

🧠 myco = fungus, rhiza = root. Fungus root.myco = 真菌，rhiza = 根。

Quick check: What does the plant give the fungus in a mycorrhiza?

Sugar.

cards.f: LI·chen
cards.b:
A partnership between a fungus and an alga or cyanobacterium living as one body.

地衣：真菌与藻类或蓝细菌结合成一体的共生体。

🧠 lichen is two organisms acting as one.地衣是两种生物合成一体。

Quick check: Which two partners make a lichen?

A fungus and an alga (or cyanobacterium).

cards.f: pi·o·NEER SPE·cies
cards.b:
One of the first species to live in bare, new ground, such as lichens on rock.

先锋物种：最先在裸地定居的物种，如岩石上的地衣。

🧠 pioneer = first to go in.pioneer = 开拓者。

Quick check: Why are lichens pioneer species?

They can grow on bare rock and help make soil.

cards.f: pen·i·CIL·lin
cards.b:
The first widely used antibiotic, made from a Penicillium mold.

青霉素：第一种广泛使用的抗生素，由青霉菌产生。

🧠 Penicillium = "little brush". Fleming noticed it in 1928.1928 年弗莱明注意到青霉。

Quick check: Is penicillin made by a fungus?

Yes, by Penicillium mold.

cards.f: fer·men·TA·tion
cards.b:
Getting energy from sugar without oxygen. Yeast makes carbon dioxide and ethanol this way.

发酵：在没有氧气的条件下从糖中获取能量；酵母由此产生二氧化碳和乙醇。

🧠 fermentum = leaven. The CO2 makes bread rise.二氧化碳让面包发起来。

Quick check: What gas makes bread dough rise?

Carbon dioxide from yeast fermentation.

cards.f: my·CO·sis
cards.b:
A disease caused by a fungus, such as athlete's foot or ringworm.

真菌病：由真菌引起的疾病，如足癣（脚气）、体癣。

🧠 myco = fungus, -osis = condition.-osis = 病症。

Quick check: Is ringworm a worm?

No. It is a fungal infection.

cards.f: ZY·gote FUN·gi
cards.b:
A group of fungi, including bread mold, that make resting zygospores and spores in sporangia.

接合菌：包括面包霉在内的真菌类群，形成休眠的接合孢子，并在孢子囊中产生孢子。

🧠 zygo = joined.zygo = 连接。

Quick check: Name a zygote fungus.

Bread mold (Rhizopus).

cards.f: SAC FUN·gi
cards.b:
A group of fungi that make spores in sac-like asci. It includes yeasts, morels and Penicillium.

子囊菌：在囊状子囊中产生孢子的真菌类群，包括酵母、羊肚菌和青霉。

🧠 ascus = Greek for wineskin (sac).ascus = 皮囊。

Quick check: What is the sac called in sac fungi?

An ascus.

cards.f: CLUB FUN·gi
cards.b:
A group of fungi that make spores on club-shaped basidia. It includes mushrooms and puffballs.

担子菌：在棒状担子上产生孢子的真菌类群，包括蘑菇和马勃。

🧠 basidium = little pedestal.basidium 意为「小底座」。

Quick check: Which group do mushrooms belong to?

Club fungi.

cards.f: AS·cus
cards.b:
A sac-shaped cell in sac fungi where spores form. Plural: asci.

子囊：子囊菌中形成孢子的囊状细胞，复数 asci。

🧠 ascus = sac.ascus = 囊。

Quick check: What forms inside an ascus?

Spores (ascospores).

cards.f: ba·SID·i·um
cards.b:
A club-shaped cell in club fungi where spores form. Plural: basidia.

担子：担子菌中形成孢子的棒状细胞，复数 basidia。

🧠 basidium = little base.basidium = 小底座。

Quick check: Where do club fungi's spores form?

On basidia.

cards.f: GILLS
cards.b:
The thin plates under a mushroom cap that carry spore-making cells.

菌褶：蘑菇菌盖下方的薄片，上面有产生孢子的细胞。

🧠 gills like a fish's gills: thin plates.像鱼鳃一样的薄片。

Quick check: Where are a mushroom's gills?

Under the cap.

cards.f: co·NID·i·a
cards.b:
Asexual spores made at the tips of hyphae, as in Penicillium.

分生孢子：在菌丝顶端产生的无性孢子，如青霉。

🧠 konis = dust.konis = 灰尘（细小）。

Quick check: Are conidia sexual or asexual spores?

Asexual.

cards.f: SEP·tum
cards.b:
A cross-wall that divides a hypha into cells. Plural: septa.

隔膜：把菌丝分隔成一个个细胞的横壁。复数 septa。

🧠 septum = fence.septum = 篱笆。

Quick check: What does a septum do in a hypha?

It divides the thread into cells.

cards.f: NU·tri·ent CY·cling
cards.b:
Decomposers returning nutrients from dead matter to the soil so plants can use them again.

养分循环：分解者把死亡物质中的养分还给土壤，让植物能再次利用。

🧠 cycle = goes round and round.养分在生物与土壤之间循环。

Quick check: How do fungi help nutrient cycling?

They decompose dead matter and return its nutrients to the soil.
